companies.title: Career pages
companies.description: Up to 50 job boards. Paste a Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee or Personio board URL, or a company's own careers page and the actor finds the board it embeds.

titleContains.title: Job title contains
titleContains.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains this text, for example "engineer". Not case sensitive.

locationContains.title: Location contains
locationContains.description: Keep only jobs whose location contains this text, for example "London" or "Remote".

department.title: Department contains
department.description: Keep only jobs whose department or team contains this text.

postedAfter.title: Posted after
postedAfter.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Jobs posted on or before this date, and jobs without a posting date, are left out.

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs the board marks as remote.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Stop collecting a board after this many jobs. Leave empty for 1,000.

maxItems.title: Max jobs in total
maxItems.description: Stop the run after this many jobs across all boards. Leave empty for 10,000.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Jobs requested per page on boards that paginate. Leave empty for 100.

maxPages.title: Max pages per board
maxPages.description: Safety limit for paginated boards. Leave empty for 100.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Pause between requests (seconds)
requestDelaySeconds.description: Minimum wait between two requests to the same site. Leave empty for 1.2 seconds.
